#ifndef __ip_h
  #define __ip_h

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN
    #ifdef __ILEC400__
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern "C"
    #endif

    #define __QBFC_EXTERN
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Header files                                                     */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/types.h>             /* common typedefs                */
#include <netinet/in.h>            /* struct in_addr                 */

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Miscellaneous defines                                            */
/*********************************************************************/

#define MAXTTL          255        /* maximum time to live (seconds) */

#define IPFRAGTTL       60         /* time to live for fragments     */
#define IPTTLDEC        1          /* subtracted when forwarding     */
#define IP_MAXPACKET    65535      /* maximum size of IP datagram    */
#define IP_MSS          576        /* default maximum segment size   */

#define IPVERSION       4          /* current IP protocol version    */

#define RFC1038                    /* define to determine which
                                      security bits to use           */

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for security bits                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef RFC1038

 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_NONE        0xff
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_UNCLASS     0x55
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_CONFID      0x7a
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_SECRET      0xad
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_TOPSECRET   0xde

#else

 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_UNCLASS     0x0000
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_CONFID      0xf135
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_EFTO        0x789a
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_MMMM        0xbc4d
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_PROG        0x5e26
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_RESTR       0xaf13
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_SECRET      0xd788
 #define        IPOPT_SECUR_TOPSECRET   0x6bc5

#endif  /* RFC1038 */

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for ip_off (fragment offset) in ip structure             */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP_DF 0x4000                    /* do not fragment flag      */
#define IP_MF 0x2000                    /* more fragments flag       */

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for ip_tos (type of service) in ip structure             */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IPTOS_NORMAL            0x00
#define IPTOS_MINCOST           0x02
#define IPTOS_RELIABILITY       0x04
#define IPTOS_THROUGHPUT        0x08
#define IPTOS_LOWDELAY          0x10

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for IP precedence (also part of ip_tos) in ip_structure  */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IPTOS_PREC_NETCONTROL           0xe0
#define IPTOS_PREC_INTERNETCONTROL      0xc0
#define IPTOS_PREC_CRITIC_ECP           0xa0
#define IPTOS_PREC_FLASHOVERRIDE        0x80
#define IPTOS_PREC_FLASH                0x60
#define IPTOS_PREC_IMMEDIATE            0x40
#define IPTOS_PREC_PRIORITY             0x20
#define IPTOS_PREC_ROUTINE              0x10

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for options                                              */
/*********************************************************************/
                                       /* Macros to mask off:        */
#define IPOPT_COPIED(o) ((o)&0x80)     /*   Option copy bit          */
#define IPOPT_CLASS(o)  ((o)&0x60)     /*   Option class bits        */
#define IPOPT_NUMBER(o) ((o)&0x1f)     /*   Option number            */

                                       /* Option class definitions:  */
#define IPOPT_CONTROL           0x00   /*   Control                  */
#define IPOPT_RESERVED1         0x20   /*   Reserved for future use  */
#define IPOPT_DEBMEAS           0x40   /*   Debugging and measurment */
#define IPOPT_RESERVED2         0x60   /*   Reserved for future use  */

#define IPOPT_EOL               0      /* end of option list         */
#define IPOPT_NOP               1      /* no operation               */

#define IPOPT_RR                7      /* record packet route        */
#define IPOPT_TS                68     /* timestamp                  */
#define IPOPT_SECURITY          130    /* provide s,c,h,tcc          */
#define IPOPT_LSRR              131    /* loose source route         */
#define IPOPT_SATID             136    /* satnet id                  */
#define IPOPT_SSRR              137    /* strict source route        */

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Offsets to fields in options other than EOL and NOP              */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IPOPT_OPTVAL            0       /* option ID                 */
#define IPOPT_OLEN              1       /* option length             */
#define IPOPT_OFFSET            2       /* offset within option      */
#define IPOPT_MINOFF            4       /* min value of above        */


/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for ipt_flg in ip_timestamp structure                    */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IPOPT_TS_TSONLY         0       /* timestamps only           */
#define IPOPT_TS_TSANDADDR      1       /* timestamps and addresses  */
#define IPOPT_TS_PRESPEC        3       /* specified modules only    */


/*********************************************************************/
/*  The sendmsg() cmsg_type value and version of QoS structure   @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP_QOS_CLASSIFICATION_DATA  0x80000001 /* Specify in     @A1A*/
                                               /* cmsg_type      @A1A*/
#define IP_QOS_CURRENT_VERSION      0x00000001 /* Current vers   @A1A*/
                                               /* of data struct @A1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for ip_qos_classification_scope                      @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP_QOS_CONNECTION_LEVEL     0x0001                    /* @A1A*/
#define IP_QOS_MESSAGE_LEVEL        0x0002                    /* @A1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/*  Defines for ip_qos_classification_type                       @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_W_APPL_TOKEN_ASCII   0x0001           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_W_APPL_TOKEN_EBCDIC  0x0002           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_EXPEDITED            0x0010           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_HIGH                 0x0020           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_MEDIUM               0x0040           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_LOW                  0x0080           /* @A1A*/
#define IP_SET_QOSLEVEL_BEST_EFFORT          0x0100           /* @A1A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct ip {                           /* IP header w/out options     */

    unsigned       ip_v:4;            /* version                     */
    unsigned       ip_hl:4;           /* header length               */
    u_char         ip_tos;            /* type of service             */
    u_short        ip_len;            /* total length            @A2C*/
    u_short        ip_id;             /* identification              */
    u_short        ip_off;            /* fragment offset field   @A2C*/
    u_char         ip_ttl;            /* time to live                */
    u_char         ip_p;              /* protocol                    */
    u_short        ip_sum;            /* checksum                    */
    struct in_addr ip_src;            /* source address              */
    struct in_addr ip_dst;            /* destination address         */

};

struct ip_timestamp {                 /* Time stamp option structure */

    u_char       ipt_code;            /* IPOPT_TS                    */
    u_char       ipt_len;             /* size of structure           */
    u_char       ipt_ptr;             /* index of current entry      */
    unsigned ipt_oflw:4;              /* overflow counter            */
    unsigned ipt_flg:4;               /* flags, see below            */
    union ipt_timestamp {             /* Recording space layout      */
        u_long  ipt_time[1];          /* Used for times only mode    */
        struct  ipt_ta {              /* Used for time/address mode: */
            struct in_addr ipt_addr;  /*  Recorded/specified address */
            u_long ipt_time;          /*  Recorded time              */
        } ipt_ta[1];
    } ipt_timestamp;

};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Ancillary data format for passing QoS classification data     @A1A*/
/* on sendmsg() API                                              @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/

struct ip_qos_classification_data {                           /* @A1A*/

    int    ip_qos_version;               /* Version of struct    @A1A*/
    int    ip_qos_classification_scope;  /* Classification scope @A1A*/
    int    ip_qos_classification_type;   /* Classification type  @A1A*/
    u_char ip_qos_reserved[12];          /* Reserved             @A1A*/
    int    ip_qos_appl_token_len;        /* Length of appl data  @A1A*/
 /* u_char ip_qos_appl_token[];   */     /* Application          @A1A*/
                                         /* classification data  @A1A*/
};                                                            /* @A1A*/

#endif /* __ip_h */

#ifdef __cplusplus
    #pragma info(restore)
#else
    #pragma checkout(resume)
#endif
